climate_pressure: Water scarcity aggravated by climate change.
documented_impact: Uneven resource availability and pressure on water users.
fcv_mediator: Regional disparities in water resources and access.
possible_consequence: UNDP describes these disparities as frequent drivers of social conflicts, without identifying violent incidents.
institutions: Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries
alternative_explanations: Water over-exploitation, allocation choices and longstanding regional inequalities also shape disputes.
uncertainty: National statement from a 2020 programme document, not a governorate-level causal estimate or current conflict chronology.
resilience_factors: Separate Kesra evidence describes local water governance and fewer disputes without attributing those disputes to climate.
compact_statement: Climate-aggravated water scarcity interacts with regional disparities and possible social conflict; no violent local incident is established.
